title: Heists
routeEta: Out of the city in {{minutes}} min
successOddsHelp: Odds are estimated from crew skills, vault type, alarm coverage and how many heroes live within flying distance. They don't account for anyone saying "this is too easy" out loud, which lowers them considerably.
oddsLow: Low odds. A hero lives two streets away.
abortBody: The crew will scatter, the getaway blimp goes back to the rental depot and any loot already in the van returns to its display case. Your plan is kept as a draft, so you can try again once the heroes calm down.
heistStarted: The heist is on. Synchronise your watches.
empty.title: No heists planned
empty.body: Every great heist starts with a floor plan, a crew you half trust and a getaway route nobody has tested. Pick a target to begin, and maybe skip the museum with the hero gift shop.
